say:1:1121104001:1.text: Hammie, are you sure we can find her here? There's no one around.
say:1:1121104001:1.source_cn: 漫漫，你确定她会来这里吗？周围一个人也没有呀。

say:2:1121104002:1.text: She was definitely here before! Didn't you notice the temperature here is a little higher than in other places?
say:2:1121104002:1.source_cn: 不不不，那位女士绝对来过！你没感觉到这里的温度比其他地...

say:3:1121104003:1.text: The land being protected by the magister's ward is supposed to feel like spring all year round, but it's as hot as summer here near the magic circle.
say:3:1121104003:1.source_cn: 有加护的土地本该四季如春，法阵这附近却像是已经入夏了！

say:4:1121104004:1.text: Then, where can we find her?
say:4:1121104004:1.source_cn: 那，接下来要去哪里找她？

say:5:1121104005:1.text: Well, the whole of <style="highlight">Ryeham</style> is protected by Magister Merlin's ward, so the magic can be felt anywhere around here...
say:5:1121104005:1.male: Well, the whole of <style="highlight">Ryeham</style> is protected by Magister Merlin's ward, so the magic can be felt anywhere around here...
say:5:1121104005:1.female: Well, the whole of <style="highlight">Ryeham</style> is protected by Magister Merlin's ward, so the magic can be felt anywhere around here...

say:6:1121104006:1.text: Why don't we head to Ryeham first?
say:6:1121104006:1.source_cn: 总之，我们先去金穗村附近找找吧！
